    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.homTensorMap_rightComp (k F R : Type u) [Field k] [Field F] [Algebra k F] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] {X Y Z : FGModuleCat R} (q : Y ⟶ Z) (a : TensorProduct k F (X ⟶ Y)) :
